## Custom NPCs on the Schedule I 0.4.7 beta

- Fix plain custom NPCs failing to construct when the native template has no framework data object. This restores both the legacy four-argument constructor and the current `ConfigurePrefab`/`WithIdentity` path.

## Compatibility and validation

- Public API signatures, save identifiers, and network payloads are unchanged.
- Both contact paths registered and were found after loading a save in local 0.4.7f5 Mono and IL2CPP beta builds. The Mono and IL2CPP contract suites passed. The reported 0.4.7f6 build was not available for local gameplay validation.
- This is a GitHub-only prerelease for the game beta. It does not publish to NuGet, Nexus Mods, or Thunderstore.
- Addresses [issue #309](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/309).
